title: Original battery polishing evaluation fixtures
purpose: Exercise protected numerical, unit, citation, metric, cell, claim and section boundaries
limitations: Examples are one acceptable realization, not the only good wording.
Literal facts and regex checks are conservative and may flag valid paraphrases.
Passing does not establish full semantic equivalence or model performance.
An assistant evaluation requires actual generated responses plus human assessment.
